Technical & price structure: In plain terms: Edita is Egypt’s snack-shelf machine — Molto croissants, Todo cakes, Bake Rolz, Freska and the HoHos/Twinkies/Tiger Tail brands it now owns across all of Africa, sold billions of packs a year through the deepest traditional-trade network on the exchange. The devaluation story is already paid for: revenue near-tripled since 2022, the balance sheet turned net-cash, and the shares six-folded. At 27.34 versus a weighted fair value of 27.68 the price is about right — the whole argument from here is whether the 34–35% gross margin survives the next move in the pound.
Monte Carlo — where could the price go?: 50,000 paths, 16 forces: the pound and the CBE easing cycle (the master variables), soft-commodity input costs, consumer purchasing power and the price-point ladder, capacity ramp-up and utilization, export and HTT-Africa traction, dividend policy and index flows. FAQ: What is the fair-value range for Edita Food Industries (EFID)? — testahil publishes a probability distribution of where EFID could trade over the next 1–3 months — the simulated 5th–95th percentile range and the central 50% — not a single price target or a buy/sell call. How is the EFID valuation calculated? — The study uses an instrument-appropriate lens — a going-concern FCFF DCF with a segment gross-profit build for a branded consumer franchise — combined with a 50,000-path Monte Carlo simulation that expresses the result as a probability distribution. Every assumption is visible and editable in the free Excel model.
